title: Natun Puhorat Asamiya Sahityar Buranji (New Light on History of Assamese Literature)
author: Dimbeshwar Neog
description: Exhaustive critical history of Assamese and Tai-Assam literature by Dimbeshwar Neog, analyzing ancient oral traditions, sanchi-bark manuscripts, Tai Buranjis composed in Tai and Assamese, court poetry, folk songs, and the historical linguistic impact of the Tai migrations on the Brahmaputra valley.
